name: baoyu-translate
tagline_zh: 粘贴链接或文件，三档翻译任选：快翻、精翻、带术语表。连「宝玉」都点赞的细节——译文保留原文格式，注释不丢。
tagline_en: Paste a link or file, pick quick, normal, or refined—glossary included. Keeps formatting and notes intact. Try it.
desc_en: This skill should be used when the user asks to "translate", "翻译", "精翻", "translate article", "translate to Chinese", "translate to English", "改成中文", "改成英文", "convert to Chinese", "localize", "本地化", "refined translation", "精细翻译", "proofread translation", "快速翻译", "快翻", "这篇文章翻译一下", or provides a URL/file with translation intent. Supports three modes (quick/normal/refined) with custom glossary suppor
why_zh: 同类工具只给单一输出，它却按需分三档，且自定义术语表能锁死专名，连注释和排版都原样保留。
why_en: Unlike one-size-fits-all translators, it offers 3 precision levels plus custom glossary, preserving notes and layout—so you get.
